creators.name: Jan Gugenheimer — TU Darmstadt
creators.role: Professor of Human-Computer Interaction at TU Darmstadt; leads a group on perceptual manipulation and everyday AR
creators.bio: Jan Gugenheimer's group studies how passthrough AR can quietly rewrite what people see, from SwitchAR (secretly swapping the camera feed for a 3D reconstruction) to ShadAR, where a spoken prompt becomes a live shader on your vision. Before Darmstadt he taught at Télécom Paris.
creators.why: Treats the passthrough image as editable material and asks what happens when people can rewrite their own perception on demand.
creators.role_zh: 达姆施塔特工业大学人机交互教授，带领一个研究感知操控与日常 AR 的小组
creators.bio_zh: Jan Gugenheimer 的团队研究视频透视 AR 如何悄悄改写人所看到的世界：SwitchAR 会在不知不觉中把摄像头画面换成三维重建，ShadAR 则把一句话的指令变成作用于视野的实时着色器。此前他在巴黎电信学院（Télécom Paris）任教。
creators.why_zh: 把透视画面当成可以编辑的材料，追问当人们能随时改写自己的感知时会发生什么。

creators.name: Yukang Yan — University of Rochester
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Computer Science at the University of Rochester; HCI researcher working on perception in XR
creators.bio: Yukang Yan's group builds XR systems that treat human perception as something to design for: at UIST 2026 his lab showed Remapping Time (with Nandi Zhang), won a Best Paper for Sonic Stage (spatial soundscapes for blind viewers) and the Best Poster for FocusAdapt (diminished reality for focus). He was previously a postdoc at Carnegie Mellon.
creators.why: Shows that the delay of a passthrough headset is not only a flaw but a design material you can stretch and compress.
creators.role_zh: 罗切斯特大学计算机科学助理教授，研究 XR 中感知问题的人机交互学者
creators.bio_zh: Yukang Yan 的团队把人的感知当作设计对象来打造 XR 系统：在 UIST 2026 上，他的实验室展示了与 Nandi Zhang 合作的 Remapping Time，凭 Sonic Stage（为盲人观众生成空间声景）获得最佳论文奖，并以 FocusAdapt（用减实现实帮助专注）获得最佳海报奖。他此前在卡内基梅隆大学做博士后。
creators.why_zh: 证明透视头显的延迟不只是缺陷，也可以是一种能拉伸、压缩的设计材料。

creators.name: Masahiro Ohta
creators.role: HCI researcher at the University of Tokyo working on extended and virtual bodies
creators.bio: Masahiro Ohta designs extended bodies that mix virtual hands, hidden robots and diminished reality. Body Sublimation, made with Takuji Narumi's lab and Kouta Minamizawa's Embodied Media group, lets a virtual hand switch between a gas that passes through walls and a solid that really grasps things.
creators.why: Uses diminished reality to hide the robot so that only a 'body' remains, turning teleoperation into a feeling of reaching.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学的人机交互研究者，研究延伸身体与虚拟身体
creators.bio_zh: Masahiro Ohta 设计把虚拟手、隐藏的机器人和减实现实混合在一起的“延伸身体”。他与鸣海拓志研究室以及南泽孝太的 Embodied Media 团队合作的 Body Sublimation，让一只虚拟手在能穿墙的“气态”和能真正抓东西的“固态”之间切换。
creators.why_zh: 用减实现实把机器人藏起来，只留下“身体”，让远程操作变成一种伸手的感觉。

creators.name: Shan-Yuan Teng — National Taiwan University
creators.role: Assistant Professor at National Taiwan University; leads the Dexterous Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Shan-Yuan Teng builds wearable devices that extend what hands can feel and do, from haptic interfaces made during his PhD in Pedro Lopes's lab at the University of Chicago to his NTU lab's UIST 2026 demos: a wrist camera that lets you see behind objects and a smartwatch with a rollable tentacle.
creators.why: Puts a second pair of eyes on the wrist, so AR shows the hand what the head cannot see.
creators.role_zh: 台湾大学助理教授，主持 Dexterous Interaction Lab
creators.bio_zh: Shan-Yuan Teng 打造能扩展双手感知与能力的可穿戴设备：从他在芝加哥大学 Pedro Lopes 实验室读博时做的触觉界面，到他在台大实验室的 UIST 2026 演示，包括一个能让你看到物体背后的腕部摄像头，以及一只带可卷曲触手的智能手表。
creators.why_zh: 在手腕上装了第二双眼睛，让 AR 把头看不到的东西展示给手。

creators.name: Abe Davis — Cornell University
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Computer Science at Cornell University; computer graphics and vision researcher
creators.bio: Abe Davis works at the meeting point of graphics, vision and interaction; he is known for the 'visual microphone' and visual vibrometry from his MIT PhD. LightShop, with Peter Michael, Andrew Arena and Harald Haraldsson, turns long-exposure light painting into an AR-guided, projector-assisted craft.
creators.why: Uses AR as a preview for a photograph that does not exist yet, so you can paint with light precisely.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学计算机科学助理教授，研究计算机图形学与视觉
creators.bio_zh: Abe Davis 的研究位于图形学、视觉与交互的交汇处，他在麻省理工读博期间以“视觉麦克风”和视觉振动测量而闻名。与 Peter Michael、Andrew Arena、Harald Haraldsson 合作的 LightShop，把长曝光光绘变成一门有 AR 引导、投影仪辅助的手艺。
creators.why_zh: 把 AR 当成一张尚未拍出的照片的预览，让人能精确地用光作画。

creators.name: CyberAgent AI Lab (Kojiro Tanaka, Takuya Iwamoto, Yuki Okafuji)
creators.role: Research lab of the Japanese internet company CyberAgent, working on avatars, robots and human-agent interaction
creators.bio: CyberAgent AI Lab studies how avatars and robots can stand in for people in everyday events. Present Drawing, by Kojiro Tanaka, Takuya Iwamoto and Yuki Okafuji, lets a headset avatar sign or draw on real paper by syncing its motion with a hidden pen plotter.
creators.why: Gives a virtual avatar a physical trace, so an absent person can still leave real ink behind.
creators.role_zh: 日本互联网公司 CyberAgent 的研究实验室，研究虚拟化身、机器人与人机交互
creators.bio_zh: CyberAgent AI Lab 研究虚拟化身和机器人如何在日常活动中代替人出场。Kojiro Tanaka、Takuya Iwamoto 和 Yuki Okafuji 的 Present Drawing，让头显里的虚拟化身通过与隐藏的笔式绘图仪同步，在真实的纸上签名或作画。
creators.why_zh: 让虚拟化身留下实体痕迹，不在场的人也能留下真正的墨迹。

creators.name: Kenri Kodaka — Kodaka Lab (Nagoya City University)
creators.role: Associate Professor at Nagoya City University; runs a lab devoted to bodily illusions
creators.bio: Kenri Kodaka's lab (with researchers such as Kaho Kagami and Yuka Makinouchi) invents strange body illusions with simple props, mirrors, sound and touch: stretched skin, soccer-ball heads, light 'teleported' into your skull, and sounds pulled inside the head by a hand. Many works are shown at UIST, SIGGRAPH Asia and in gallery exhibitions.
creators.why: Treats the body as a display that can be fooled, which is exactly what AR designers need to understand.
creators.role_zh: 名古屋市立大学副教授，主持一个专门研究身体错觉的实验室
creators.bio_zh: 小鷹研理（Kenri Kodaka）的实验室（成员包括 Kaho Kagami、牧野内柚香 Yuka Makinouchi 等）用简单的道具、镜子、声音和触摸发明各种奇特的身体错觉：被拉长的皮肤、足球头、被“传送”进脑袋的光，以及被一只手拉进头里的声音。许多作品在 UIST、SIGGRAPH Asia 和美术馆展览中展出。
creators.why_zh: 把身体当成一块可以被骗过的显示屏，这正是 AR 设计者需要理解的。

creators.name: Peisen Xu
creators.role: PhD researcher at the National University of Singapore working on mixed-reality interfaces for drones, with ENAC (University of Toulouse)
creators.bio: Peisen Xu studies how people can supervise many autonomous drones at once. FleetScape, made with Jérémie Garcia, Peter Cleveland, Wei Tsang Ooi and Christophe Jouffrais, turns a drone fleet into a mixed-reality sand table you walk around.
creators.why: Shrinks a whole mission into a tabletop world you can read and steer with your hands.
creators.role_zh: 新加坡国立大学博士研究者，与法国国立民航大学（图卢兹大学）合作研究无人机的混合现实界面
creators.bio_zh: Peisen Xu 研究人如何同时监管大量自主无人机。他与 Jérémie Garcia、Peter Cleveland、Wei Tsang Ooi 和 Christophe Jouffrais 合作的 FleetScape，把整个无人机编队变成一张可以绕着走的混合现实沙盘。
creators.why_zh: 把整场任务缩小成桌面上的一个世界，用双手就能读懂和操控。

works.title: ShadAR
works.description: In a passthrough headset you say what you want to see, such as 'blur all people' or 'make everything red except my coffee', and within seconds that effect is applied to the live view of the real world. By Yanni Mei, Samuel Hartenstein, Jonas Wombacher, Florian Müller and Jan Gugenheimer (TU Darmstadt), UIST 2026 paper and demo.
works.description_zh: 戴上视频透视头显，说出你想看到的效果，比如“把所有人都模糊掉”或“除了我的咖啡，全部变成红色”，几秒钟后这个效果就作用在真实世界的实时画面上。作者为达姆施塔特工业大学的 Yanni Mei、Samuel Hartenstein、Jonas Wombacher、Florian Müller 和 Jan Gugenheimer，发表于 UIST 2026（论文与演示）。
works.idea_en: Your vision becomes promptable: a sentence turns into a filter on reality.
works.idea_zh: 视觉可以被“提示”：一句话就变成现实的滤镜。
works.technique: An LLM interprets the spoken request, an object detector (YOLO) finds the targeted regions in the passthrough image, and the LLM writes a pixel shader that is injected into the passthrough pipeline and masked to those regions in real time.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型理解口头指令，目标检测模型（YOLO）在透视画面中找出目标区域，再由大语言模型写出像素着色器，实时注入透视渲染管线并只作用于这些区域。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone camera filter that takes a typed sentence, sends it to a language model with the instruction 'reply only with a GLSL fragment shader', and applies the result to the live camera feed in the browser (WebGL or p5.js); collect the funniest and most useful prompts from the class. Twist: limit each shader to one detected object class, so the effect only touches people, cups or plants.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机摄像头滤镜：输入一句话，把它连同“只回复一段 GLSL 片元着色器”的指令发给语言模型，再在浏览器里（WebGL 或 p5.js）把结果套到实时摄像头画面上；收集全班最好玩、最有用的提示语。变体：让每个着色器只作用于一种检测到的物体类别，比如只改变人、杯子或植物。

works.title: Remapping Time in Augmented Reality
works.description: A passthrough headset quietly slows the world down when something fast happens, such as a card flashed for a split second, then catches back up to real time; in tests, people identified briefly shown cards about twice as often. By Nandi Zhang and Yukang Yan (University of Rochester), UIST 2026 paper and demo.
works.description_zh: 当有快速发生的事情，比如一张扑克牌只闪现一瞬间，视频透视头显会悄悄把世界放慢，之后再追回到实时；实验中，人们认出这些一闪而过的牌的准确率大约翻了一倍。作者为罗切斯特大学的 Nandi Zhang 和 Yukang Yan，发表于 UIST 2026（论文与演示）。
works.idea_en: Passthrough AR can bend time, not only space: slow reality down for a moment, then catch up.
works.idea_zh: 透视 AR 不只能弯曲空间，也能弯曲时间：把现实放慢片刻，再追回来。
works.technique: The camera stream is buffered and played back at a variable rate modelled as a first-order dynamical system that balances how much delay builds up during slow motion against how quickly it is recovered; slow-downs are triggered by the user or by the system.
works.technique_zh: 摄像头画面先被缓存，再以可变速率回放；速率由一个一阶动态系统控制，在慢放时累积的延迟和之后追回延迟的速度之间取得平衡；慢放可以由用户触发，也可以由系统自动触发。
works.exercise_en: Make a browser 'slow-motion mirror': buffer the last few seconds of webcam frames, and when the user presses a key (or when frame-to-frame motion spikes) play the buffer at half speed, then speed up to 1.5× until you are back to live. Test it by flashing playing cards in front of the camera. Twist: let the motion of a chosen object, not the whole scene, decide when time slows down.
works.exercise_zh: 做一面浏览器里的“慢动作镜子”：缓存摄像头最近几秒的画面，当用户按下按键（或画面帧间运动突然变大）时以半速播放缓存，然后以 1.5 倍速追回到实时。在摄像头前快速闪过扑克牌来测试。变体：不看整个画面，而是让某个指定物体的运动来决定何时放慢时间。

works.title: Gaze-Contingent Dual Animation with High-Speed Projection
works.description: One projected picture hides two animations: looking at it freely you see one, but when your eyes follow a moving character a second animation appears, with no camera or eye tracker involved. By Hiroto Tsutsumoto, Ryusuke Miyazaki and Shio Miyafuji (Koike Lab, Institute of Science Tokyo), UIST 2026 demo.
works.description_zh: 一幅投影画面里藏着两段动画：随意观看时看到的是一段，当你的眼睛跟着一个移动的角色走时，第二段动画就浮现出来，全程不需要摄像头或眼动仪。作者为东京科学大学小池研究室的 Hiroto Tsutsumoto、Ryusuke Miyazaki 和 Shio Miyafuji，UIST 2026 演示。
works.idea_en: How your eyes move decides which story you see, with no sensor at all.
works.idea_zh: 你的眼睛怎么动，决定了你看到哪个故事，完全不需要传感器。
works.technique: A high-speed projector splits each frame into very fast sub-frames; for a still gaze they average into animation A, while smooth-pursuit eye movement shifts the sub-frames across the retina so they integrate into animation B (likely an extension of the lab's motion-contingent temporal decomposition).
works.technique_zh: 高速投影仪把每一帧拆成极快的子帧：视线静止时它们平均成动画 A，而眼睛平滑追踪时，子帧在视网膜上错开位置，叠加成动画 B（很可能沿用了该实验室基于运动的时间分解方法）。
works.exercise_en: Explore the eye as a display filter with a 120–240 Hz monitor: alternate two images every frame with p5.js and compare what you see while staring versus while tracking a moving dot across the screen; then hide a message that only appears while tracking. Twist: project it onto a wall and turn it into a game where players must follow a character with their eyes to read the clue.
works.exercise_zh: 用 120–240 Hz 显示器把眼睛当作显示滤镜来探索：用 p5.js 每帧交替两幅图像，比较盯着看和眼睛追着屏幕上移动的小点看时分别看到什么；然后藏一条只有在追视时才出现的信息。变体：把它投到墙上，做成一个游戏，玩家必须用眼睛追随一个角色才能读出线索。

works.title: Relative-Motion-Aware Color Presentation
works.description: A projected sign shows a different colour image depending on which way you walk past it: people moving left see one picture, people moving right see another, and no camera tracks anyone. By Ryusuke Miyazaki, Shio Miyafuji and Hideki Koike (Institute of Science Tokyo), UIST 2026 paper.
works.description_zh: 一块投影广告牌会根据你从它前面走过的方向显示不同的彩色图像：向左走的人看到一幅画，向右走的人看到另一幅，而且没有任何摄像头追踪行人。作者为东京科学大学的 Ryusuke Miyazaki、Shio Miyafuji 和小池英树（Hideki Koike），发表于 UIST 2026。
works.idea_en: A sensor-free display where your own walking direction is the input.
works.idea_zh: 一块不用传感器的显示屏，你行走的方向本身就是输入。
works.technique: Target images are decomposed in time and shown with a high-speed projector so that, when a viewer moves relative to the surface, the sub-frames smear across the retina and recombine into the image for that direction, including specific colour perception.
works.technique_zh: 目标图像被拆解成时间序列，用高速投影仪播放；当观者相对屏幕移动时，这些子帧在视网膜上拖开并重新组合，形成对应该方向的图像，包括特定的颜色感知。
works.exercise_en: Make a 'walk-by' poster with a high-refresh screen: show thin vertical stripes that flash in sequence, and film it with a phone panning left and right to see how motion reveals different patterns; design one message for each direction. Twist: place two such posters in a corridor so that walking back reveals the second half of a story.
works.exercise_zh: 用高刷新率屏幕做一张“路过才看得见”的海报：让细竖条纹按顺序闪烁，用手机左右平移拍摄，观察运动如何显出不同图案；为每个方向各设计一条信息。变体：在走廊里放两张这样的海报，让人往回走时看到故事的后半段。

works.title: Body Sublimation
works.description: In a Quest 3 your real hand and a nearby robot arm are erased from view, and a stretchable virtual hand becomes your body: as 'gas' it passes through monitors, curtains and walls, then turns 'solid' on the other side and really grabs a snack, moved by the hidden robot. By Masahiro Ohta, Reigo Ban, Hideaki Nii, Guillaume Gourmelen, Takuji Narumi, Mauricio Sousa, Takatoshi Yoshida and Kouta Minamizawa (University of Tokyo and Keio KMD), UIST 2026.
works.description_zh: 戴上 Quest 3，你的真手和旁边的机械臂都从视野中被抹去，一只可以伸长的虚拟手成为你的身体：处于“气态”时，它能穿过显示器、帘子和墙；到了另一边变成“固态”，由隐藏的机器人真的抓起一包零食。作者为东京大学与庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科的 Masahiro Ohta、Reigo Ban、Hideaki Nii、Guillaume Gourmelen、鸣海拓志（Takuji Narumi）、Mauricio Sousa、Takatoshi Yoshida 和南泽孝太（Kouta Minamizawa），发表于 UIST 2026。
works.idea_en: Your extended hand changes state like matter, ghostly when it travels and solid when it grabs.
works.idea_zh: 延伸出去的手像物质一样变换状态：移动时像幽灵，抓取时变成实体。
works.technique: Quest 3 hand tracking drives a Go-Go-style amplified virtual hand; Gaussian-splatting-based diminished reality removes the real hand and an xArm7 with a PSYONIC Ability Hand from the passthrough, and the hand switches to the gas state whenever the robot cannot follow because of collisions, speed or workspace limits.
works.technique_zh: Quest 3 的手部追踪驱动一只按 Go-Go 方式放大伸展距离的虚拟手；基于高斯泼溅的减实现实把真手和 xArm7 机械臂（配 PSYONIC Ability Hand）从透视画面中去掉；每当机器人因碰撞、速度或工作空间限制跟不上时，虚拟手就切换为气态。
works.exercise_en: Prototype a two-state 'ghost hand' in a passthrough or WebXR scene: a virtual hand that extends with arm speed, goes semi-transparent and passes through virtual walls, and becomes opaque and collides when you pinch. Stage the 'solid' moment with a teammate who secretly moves the real object (Wizard of Oz). Twist: give each state its own sound and haptic cue so the change of matter can be felt.
works.exercise_zh: 在透视或 WebXR 场景里做一只有两种状态的“幽灵手”：虚拟手随手臂速度伸长，半透明时能穿过虚拟墙，捏合时变得不透明并产生碰撞。用“绿野仙踪”方法，让队友在“固态”时刻偷偷移动真实物体。变体：给每种状态配上各自的声音和触觉提示，让物态变化能被感觉到。

works.title: See Through With The Hands
works.description: A depth camera on the wrist looks where your eyes cannot, and the headset shows that hidden view lined up with your hand, so you can reach behind a panel and screw on a nut you cannot see. By Wei-Tang Hsu and Shan-Yuan Teng (National Taiwan University), UIST 2026 demo.
works.description_zh: 手腕上的深度摄像头看向眼睛看不到的地方，头显把这个被遮挡的画面与你的手对齐显示，于是你能把手伸到面板后面，拧上一颗看不见的螺母。作者为台湾大学的 Wei-Tang Hsu 和 Shan-Yuan Teng，UIST 2026 演示。
works.idea_en: X-ray vision that comes from the hand, not from a scan: the hand sees for itself.
works.idea_zh: 透视能力来自手，而不是来自扫描：手自己会看。
works.technique: A wrist-mounted depth camera on a small motorised mount that adapts its angle to the hand pose; its depth image is reprojected into the headset's viewpoint so the occluded scene appears in place, with no external tracking.
works.technique_zh: 深度摄像头装在手腕上一个小型电动支架上，会随手势调整角度；它的深度图像被重投影到头显视角，使被遮挡的场景出现在原本的位置上，无需任何外部追踪。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone or small camera to your wrist, stream it to a laptop or headset view, and try to plug a cable or pick a key from inside a closed box using only that view; then overlay the stream on a photo of the box so it looks like a hole. Twist: compare showing the feed as a floating window versus aligned to the hand, and time both.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机或小摄像头绑在手腕上，把画面传到电脑或头显里，只靠这个画面尝试在封闭的盒子里插上一根线或拿出一把钥匙；然后把画面叠在盒子的照片上，让它看起来像开了一个洞。变体：比较把画面显示为浮动窗口和对齐在手上两种方式，分别计时。

works.title: CinemaWorld
works.description: While you watch a film on a normal screen, your living room joins in: snow from the scene drifts around you, objects from the set appear beside the sofa and the room's light shifts with the shot, all generated automatically from the movie. By Keiichi Ihara, DaeHo Lee, Manato Abe, Hye-Young Jo and Ryo Suzuki, UIST 2026 paper and demo.
works.description_zh: 你在普通屏幕上看电影时，客厅也一起“入戏”：画面里的雪飘到你身边，片场里的物件出现在沙发旁，房间的光线随镜头变化，这些都是根据电影自动生成的。作者为 Keiichi Ihara、DaeHo Lee、Manato Abe、Hye-Young Jo 和 Ryo Suzuki，发表于 UIST 2026（论文与演示）。
works.idea_en: A 2D movie leaks out of the screen into your room as generated mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 一部二维电影溢出屏幕，以生成的混合现实形式进入你的房间。
works.technique: Films are preprocessed by multimodal LLMs that pick key moments and augmentation types (particles, surrounding objects, textures, character effects, lighting); generative 3D models create the assets, which are placed in the viewer's room on Meta Quest 3 and synchronised with the playback.
works.technique_zh: 先用多模态大语言模型预处理电影，挑出关键时刻和增强类型（粒子、周围物体、纹理、角色效果、灯光）；再由生成式 3D 模型制作资产，在 Meta Quest 3 上放进观众的房间，并与播放同步。
works.exercise_en: Pick a two-minute film clip, list five moments where something could leave the screen (rain, a ball, a sound, a light change), and build them as timed AR effects in WebXR or Lens Studio that play next to a laptop showing the clip. Twist: let a language model read the subtitles and suggest the effects, then compare its choices with yours.
works.exercise_zh: 选一段两分钟的电影片段，列出五个可以“跑出屏幕”的时刻（雨、一个球、一个声音、一次光线变化），在 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 中把它们做成定时 AR 效果，在播放片段的笔记本电脑旁出现。变体：让语言模型读字幕并提出效果建议，再和你自己的选择对比。

works.title: LightShop
works.description: A light painter wears a headset that previews the long-exposure photo before it is taken, guides the handheld light along the planned path, and a projector-camera rig keeps only the light from the intended source, so the painter's body and stray light vanish from the result. By Peter Michael, Andrew Arena, Harald Haraldsson and Abe Davis (Cornell University), UIST 2026.
works.description_zh: 光绘者戴着头显，可以在拍摄前预览长曝光照片，并沿着规划好的路径引导手中的光源；投影仪与相机组成的系统只保留目标光源打出的光，让画者的身体和杂散光从成片中消失。作者为康奈尔大学的 Peter Michael、Andrew Arena、Harald Haraldsson 和 Abe Davis，发表于 UIST 2026。
works.idea_en: AR as a preview of a photograph that only exists once the light has finished moving.
works.idea_zh: AR 成为一张照片的预览，而这张照片要等光走完才会存在。
works.technique: The HMD tracks the handheld emitter in real time and overlays the target strokes and accumulated result; a computational exposure strategy uses a projector and camera to isolate light cast by the intended emitter on the scene.
works.technique_zh: 头显实时追踪手持光源，并叠加显示目标笔画和累积效果；一种计算曝光策略借助投影仪和相机，只分离出目标光源投在场景上的光。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone AR light-painting guide: anchor a 3D path (a name, a spiral around a chair) in space, then have one student follow it with a phone flashlight while another shoots a long exposure; compare free-hand and guided results. Twist: show the accumulated 'photo so far' live in AR by tracing the phone's own position.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 光绘引导：在空间中锚定一条三维路径（一个名字、绕椅子的螺旋），让一名同学拿手机手电筒沿路径移动，另一名同学拍长曝光；对比徒手和有引导的结果。变体：追踪手机自身的位置，在 AR 中实时显示“目前为止的照片”。

works.title: Present Drawing
works.description: A fan in a headset watches an avatar sign a real autograph board in front of them; the ink is real, drawn by a pen plotter hidden behind the board that moves in sync with the avatar's hand, live or replayed. By Kojiro Tanaka, Takuya Iwamoto and Yuki Okafuji (CyberAgent AI Lab), UIST 2026.
works.description_zh: 戴着头显的粉丝看着一个虚拟化身在面前的真实签名板上签名；墨迹是真的，由藏在签名板后面、与化身手部同步移动的笔式绘图仪画出，可以是现场直播，也可以是回放。作者为 CyberAgent AI Lab 的 Kojiro Tanaka、Takuya Iwamoto 和 Yuki Okafuji，发表于 UIST 2026。
works.idea_en: A virtual avatar that leaves a physical trace, so an absent star can still sign your paper.
works.idea_zh: 一个能留下实体痕迹的虚拟化身，即使明星不在场，也能在你的纸上签名。
works.technique: The avatar's hand motion is synchronised with a customised pen plotter whose mechanism is hidden from the observer, and the HMD places the avatar so its pen tip matches the plotter's pen; motion comes from a live performer, a recording or the system itself.
works.technique_zh: 化身的手部动作与一台定制笔式绘图仪同步，绘图仪的机构对观众隐藏；头显中化身的位置让它的笔尖正好对上绘图仪的笔；动作可以来自现场表演者、录制数据或系统本身。
works.exercise_en: Pair a cheap pen plotter (or a phone on a slow-moving rig) with an AR character in Lens Studio or WebXR: record a signature as a path, play it on the plotter and animate the character's hand along the same path at the same speed. Twist: let a remote classmate draw on a tablet so the avatar draws live in your room.
works.exercise_zh: 把一台便宜的笔式绘图仪（或装在慢速移动支架上的手机）和 Lens Studio 或 WebXR 里的 AR 角色配对：把一个签名录成路径，在绘图仪上播放，同时让角色的手以相同速度沿同一路径运动。变体：让远程的同学在平板上画，化身就在你的房间里实时作画。

works.title: Neighborhood
works.description: Two people in different rooms walk toward each other and the remote room appears as if it were next door, so each can step across into the other's space while their own furniture stays usable. By Taehei Kim, Hyeshim Kim, Jihun Shin, Hyeonjin Kim and Sung-Hee Lee (KAIST), UIST 2026.
works.description_zh: 两个身处不同房间的人朝彼此走去，远方的房间就像在隔壁一样出现，每个人都可以跨进对方的空间，同时自己房间里的家具依然可用。作者为 KAIST 的 Taehei Kim、Hyeshim Kim、Jihun Shin、Hyeonjin Kim 和 Sung-Hee Lee，发表于 UIST 2026。
works.idea_en: Telepresence as a doorway: walk out of your room and into a friend's real room.
works.idea_zh: 把远程临场变成一道门：走出自己的房间，走进朋友真实的房间。
works.technique: Both rooms are captured and continuously re-aligned at runtime so that a chosen boundary area of each room joins the other, and avatars and spaces are transmitted together in mixed reality, keeping both rooms visible and walkable.
works.technique_zh: 两个房间都被采集下来，并在运行时持续重新对齐，让每个房间选定的边界区域与对方相接；虚拟化身和空间一起以混合现实传输，两个房间都保持可见、可行走。
works.exercise_en: Scan two classrooms or corners with a phone (Polycam or a Gaussian splat), and in WebXR place the second scan so it starts at a doorway of the first; walk through the doorway and swap who is 'home'. Twist: find the best joining wall automatically by matching the free floor area in both scans.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机（Polycam 或高斯泼溅）扫描两间教室或两个角落，在 WebXR 中把第二个扫描放在第一个房间的一道门口之后；走过门口，再交换谁是“主场”。变体：通过比较两个扫描中的空地面积，自动找出最适合相接的墙。

works.title: Hands-On Magnetic Head Illusion
works.description: A sound plays from a speaker in front of you, but when someone places a hand on your head the sound seems to jump inside your skull, and it leaves again when the hand lifts. By Kaho Kagami and Kenri Kodaka, UIST 2025 demo.
works.description_zh: 声音从你面前的扬声器传出，可当有人把手放在你头上时，声音仿佛跳进了你的脑袋里；手一抬起，声音又离开了。作者为 Kaho Kagami 和小鷹研理（Kenri Kodaka），UIST 2025 演示。
works.idea_en: Touch moves sound: a hand on the head pulls an outside sound into your skull.
works.idea_zh: 触摸可以移动声音：放在头上的一只手，把外面的声音拉进你的脑袋。
works.technique: An audio-tactile 'magnet effect': a sound source is played while the head is touched, and the brain binds the sound to the touched body part; their study found the effect depends on the head being touched, not on touch in general.
works.technique_zh: 一种视听触觉的“磁铁效应”：在头部被触摸时播放声音，大脑会把声音和被触摸的身体部位绑定；他们的实验发现，这个效应取决于被触摸的是头部，而不是有没有触摸。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, play a short sound from a phone 1 m in front of a seated partner with closed eyes, and ask them to point to where the sound is with and without your hand resting on their head; then try the shoulder and the hand. Twist: design an AR audio moment that uses this, such as a voice that 'enters' you when a virtual character touches your head.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：让同伴闭眼坐好，在其面前 1 米处用手机播放一段短音，请对方在你把手放在他头上和不放时分别指出声音的位置；再试试放在肩膀和手上。变体：设计一个利用这种效应的 AR 音频时刻，比如当虚拟角色触碰你的头时，一个声音“进入”你体内。

works.title: FleetScape
works.description: A drone pilot supervises a whole fleet inspecting a building as a mixed-reality sand table: the building, flight paths, safety zones and wind float on the table, and the pilot can grab one drone to steer it by hand and release it back to autonomy. By Peisen Xu, Jérémie Garcia, Peter Cleveland, Wei Tsang Ooi and Christophe Jouffrais, UIST 2026 paper and demo.
works.description_zh: 无人机操作员把整支执行建筑巡检的编队当作一张混合现实沙盘来监管：建筑、航线、安全区和风场浮在桌面上，操作员可以抓住某一架无人机亲手操控，再把它放回自主飞行。作者为 Peisen Xu、Jérémie Garcia、Peter Cleveland、Wei Tsang Ooi 和 Christophe Jouffrais，发表于 UIST 2026（论文与演示）。
works.idea_en: Supervise a swarm by shrinking its world onto a table you can walk around.
works.idea_zh: 把编队的世界缩小到一张可以绕着走的桌子上，以此来监管一群无人机。
works.technique: A high-fidelity building-inspection simulation streams synchronised multi-drone and environment data into a headset, rendered as layered world-in-miniature visualisations of mission, safety and environment that support switching between manual intervention and autonomous supervision.
works.technique_zh: 一个高保真建筑巡检仿真把同步的多机与环境数据实时传入头显，渲染为分层的“微缩世界”可视化，包括任务、安全和环境图层，并支持在人工干预和自主监管之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Build a tabletop AR 'mission table' with WebXR or Lens Studio: a miniature of your school building with five simulated drones following waypoints, plus a toggle for a wind layer and a no-fly layer; let a classmate grab one drone and redirect it. Twist: show what each drone will do in the next 10 seconds as a ghost trail.
works.exercise_zh: 用 WebXR 或 Lens Studio 做一张桌面 AR“任务沙盘”：学校建筑的微缩模型上有五架沿航点飞行的模拟无人机，可以切换风场图层和禁飞区图层；让同学抓起一架无人机改变它的航线。变体：用幽灵轨迹显示每架无人机接下来 10 秒的动作。

leads.name: Andreas Fender & Dieter Schmalstieg (University of Stuttgart) — Multiverse Architecture for Desired Realities
leads.why: UIST 2026 tech-concept paper: an immersive app splits into parallel universes whenever input is ambiguous and quietly collapses back to the one you interact with. Only the 30 s ACM preview (v2VQGaMKry8) is online and it was not possible to see what the demos show; recheck for a full video.

leads.name: Jonas Wombacher, Florian Müller & Jan Gugenheimer — Towards Choice Blindness in Extended Reality
leads.why: UIST 2026 poster: uses SwitchAR to secretly rotate or rearrange a whole room so people defend a choice they never made. No video yet.

leads.name: Kenri Kodaka Lab (Yuka Makinouchi, Kaho Kagami et al.) — Quad Hemispheres and In-Head Particle ASMR
leads.why: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 XR: head tilting makes VR spheres feel like they roll inside your head; touching extended ears turns sound into particles inside the head. A student-channel video exists (BoeWp9yhbN4) but the program has no abstract yet; recheck after the conference (1–4 Dec).

leads.name: Yuya Kato, Masahiro Ohta et al. — Stretched Reality
leads.why: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Emerging Technologies: deformable immersive environments through attention-aware hand redirection. No video found yet.

leads.name: Tomoki Noguchi, Naoya Koizumi et al. (UEC) — CAST-Table
leads.why: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Emerging Technologies: co-located, walk-around mid-air images that work with tangible objects on a table. No 2026 video found yet; the Koizumi lab channel posts mid-air image demos.

leads.name: Mirror Skin — in-situ visualisation of robot touch intent on robot skin (UIST 2026)
leads.why: Cephalopod-inspired robot skin that mirrors an image of the human body part it is about to touch. 30 s ACM preview only (ZEPNhaae06I); a robot display rather than AR, but a strong idea for situated intent displays.
